attempts.response: NO_IMPROVEMENT The 3-instruction `and 3 / add / icmp ugt 4` is the exact modulo-2^32 semantics `((addr&3)+size mod 2^32)>4` which already implies `size>1`; any single-overflow `or -4 / uadd.with.overflow` formulation is true for `size in [2^32-low,2^32-1]` where the wrapped sum is 0..2 and must be false, so correcting it needs the extra no-overflow test and is slower.
